output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. 'mintedAmount' is a user-controlled input, allowing it to be set to a value extremely high, and when 'totalSupply' is added with 'mintedAmount', the overflow causes it to become very low, effectively locking up assets.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is very large, '_balanceOf[_from] -= _value' will cause an overflow and decrease '_from's balance, and '_balanceOf[_to] += _value' will cause an overflow and increase '_to's balance excessively, granting unauthorized access to large sums of tokens.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is very large, '_balanceOf[_from] -= _value' will cause an overflow and decrease '_from's balance, and 'allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value' will cause an overflow and decrease the owner's allowance, granting unauthorized access to large sums of tokens.

The 'burn' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. 'mintedAmount' is a user-controlled input, allowing it to be set to a value extremely high, and when 'totalSupply' is subtracted by 'mintedAmount', the overflow causes it to become very large, effectively granting unauthorized access to large sums of tokens.

The 'burnFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is very large, 'balanceOf[_from]' is subtracted by '_value', an overflow causes it to become very large, effectively locking up assets.
